_note: Kimi-K3 open-ended optimizer case: ONE KDA (Kimi Delta Attention, linear-attn) decoder layer of Kimi-K3 on sglang v0.5.20, B200, in the cookbook production shape (attention TP8 rank = 12 heads, EP8 rank = 112 mxfp4 routed experts, bf16 KDA state). Metric = CUDA-graph replay time of the decode step. No PR answer key: the judge scores improvement over the pristine tree with a correctness gate (output + post-step recurrent state vs a seeded golden).

render.METRIC: CUDA-graph decode-step latency of one Kimi-K3 KDA decoder layer
render.MODEL_NAME: Kimi-K3 (moonshotai/Kimi-K3): one KDA (linear-attention) decoder layer, as it runs on one B200 of the production TP8/EP8 deployment (12 attention heads, 112 local mxfp4 experts, bf16 recurrent state)
render.WORKLOAD: batched decode, one token per request per step: B=128 requests at context 8192 (primary), plus B=32 and B=1 at 8192 (must not regress)
render.REBUILD_CMD: find /sgl-workspace/sglang/python/sglang -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; cd /tmp && python3 /tmp/kimi_single_layer_decode.py --point 1,8192 --attn-type kda --moe-backend flashinfer_mxfp4 --attn-heads 12 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --experts 112 --ep 8 --cuda-graph --iters 5 --warmup 2 && echo LAYER_SMOKE_OK
